title: System Historian
subtitle: Reconstructs a system's story, covering the decisions that shaped it, the changes made, the problems hit and how each was fixed, and the trade-offs accepted, in time order.
lede: Reconstructs a system's story, covering the decisions that shaped it, the changes made, the problems hit and how each was fixed, and the trade-offs accepted, in time order. It ties that story to what the code looks like today.
who: An engineering manager, auditor or new owner of a system asking "how did it end up like this"
author: Corey James
